rootCause: The inspector opened the original source blend, which had no persisted baked-state binding for attempt-17, then pointed its MODULAR cache setting directly at the retained cache. decision: The diagnostic and its PASS receipt are scientifically invalid and must never support a geometry conclusion. Do not rebuild inside attempt-17. Any replacement must rebake into a fresh root, save a baked-state blend there, make a complete fresh diagnostic copy of the cache, and inspect only the copy.
